The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. programme.title: Tony Deyo
programme.desc: Tony Deyo is a stand-up comedian known most notably for his sharp, quick material and near-perfect comedic timing almost certainly gained from his years as a professional symphony musician. New York City's Village Voice calls him “one of the tightest joke writers in the business.” In 2013, he made his late night television debut on CONAN. Within a year, he had added appearances on The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson, AXS TV's Gotham Comedy Live, and Comics Unleashed with Byron Allen. His latest album, Comedy Road Trip, landed on the Billboard Magazine comedy chart and debuted as the #1 selling stand-up album on iTunes. With over 50 stand-up clips available, he has steadily become one of the most prolific comedians on YouTube. He performed at the prestigious HBO Aspen Comedy Festival, was named one of the year's best by the New York Post, and can be heard regularly on SiriusXM Satellite Radio.

programme.title: Lamont Ferguson
programme.desc: Ferguson has appeared on the Tonight Show, Comedy Central, Comics Unleashed and ABCís Family Channel. He was the Winner of the Seattle International Comedy Competition, Three time semi-finalist at the Boston Comedy Festival, Finalist in the San Francisco International Comedy Competition and named ëBest of Festî at the Detroit, Lucky Eagle and San Luis Obispo Comedy Festivals. He has the distinction of being one of the only comics in the country that has opened for all of the following comedians: Steve Harvey, George Lopez, Larry Miller, Garry Shandling, Richard Jeni, and George Carlin.

programme.title: Mary Mack
programme.desc: Folk Humorist Mary Mack performs her sometimes-musical comedy at festivals, colleges, clubs, casinos and anywhere you can find a llama or a buffet line. She has acted in cartoons, weird student films, and commercials that urge you to buy food for your hamster. (Mary is totally FOR feeding your hamster.) A favorite on radio shows and podcasts around the country, including Marc Maron's WTF Podcast, The Bob and Tom Show, and American Public Media's WITS, Mary played the leading character Dylan on Fox's new late night cartoon Golan the Insatiable, season one. Her voice has also been heard in the cult favorite Aqua Teen Hunger Force on Cartoon Network's Adult Swim. Mack's comedy (spotted with occasional mandolin or clarinet outbursts) has been seen in the Vancouver Comedy Fest, The Andy Kaufman Awards, Montreal's Just For Laughs Festival, and the San Francisco Sketch Fest as one of "The Dozen" up and coming headliners designated by the festival. She had her national TV debut on Comedy Central's Live at Gotham and NBC's Last Comic Standing.

programme.title: Andy Hendrickson
programme.desc: Andy Hendrickson has multiple TV appearances including: The Late Show with David Letterman, The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson, Gotham Comedy Live, NBC/Seeso's The Guest List and more. Internationally, Andy has performed at clubs and festivals throughout the world, including Canada, England, Holland, and Ireland. He also performed for our troops on Outback's Feeding Freedom Tour that provided entertainment for the troops on military bases across Afghanistan.

programme.title: Greg Warren
programme.desc: Greg Warren is a nationally touring headliner and has been featured on Late Night with Seth Meyers, Last Comic Standing, Comedy Central Presents, The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson, BET and CMT. Greg is a fan favorite on the nationally syndicated Bob and Tom Radio Show and can be heard daily on Sirius/XM.

programme.title: Arvin Mitchell
programme.desc: With an array of impressions, stories, gestures and faces, Arvin's memorable performance is sure to please. As the former co-host of BET's Club Comic View, Arvin has been featured on Kevin Heart's “One Mic Stand”, Tony Rocks “The Funny Spot” as well as entertaining our troops abroad. Nominated as one of NBC's Stand Up for Diversity top comics Arvin continues to tour colleges, clubs, cruise ships & churches.

programme.title: Zoltan Kaszas
programme.desc: Zoltan Kaszas was born in Budapest, Hungary and raised in San Diego, California. He first stepped onstage at the age of nineteen and he was hooked immediately. Zoltan's diverse background and life experience along with his conversational storytelling style has been entertaining audiences at comedy clubs and colleges across the country. His comedy has also been featured on the television show Laughs on FOX, on radio at SiriusXM in print in The Atlantic and has helped him win The Seattle International Comedy Competition &The San Diego Comedy Festival. When he isn't traveling the world Zoltan can be found at home with his wife Brittany and their cat Jessica, you can keep up with him on his weekly podcast available on iTunes called This Week In Zoltan.

programme.title: RiffTrax: The RiffTrax Yule Log
programme.desc: We're proud to present a new kind of fireplace video, one filled with festive comedy and music to be enjoyed by all! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Stone Cold
programme.desc: Stone Cold tells the story of John Stone, a renegade cop played by NFL player Brian Bosworth. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Martial Law 2 Under Cover
programme.desc: When Detective Sean Thompson's ex-partner winds up dead, all eyes are on the main suspect: the town's evil karate billionaire. This feature is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K)

programme.title: RiffTrax: Uninvited
programme.desc: Uninvited is a horror movie written and directed by Star Games and Final Justice mastermind Greydon Clark, so it's not surprising that Greydon Clark put himself in the movie. What is surprising? Pretty much everything else.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Death Promise
programme.desc: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy 70's karate classic! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin, and Bill from RiffTrax.

programme.title: Total Riff Off Episode 6: Brazilian Bigfoot
programme.desc: Join Mike, Kevin, and Bill for another baffling snipe hunt with our favorite intrepid explorer Richard Terry in Total Riff Off Episode 6: Brazilian Bigfoot!

programme.title: El amor te encuentra en San Valentín
programme.desc: Kennedy Blaine hereda un magnífico rancho en la pequeña población de Valentine y decide visitar la propiedad para ponerlo en venta. Cuando llega, Derek, el capataz, la confunde con una intrusa y la relación no empieza con buen pie.

programme.title: Un Puñado de Polvo
programme.desc: Tras siete años de matrimonio, Lady Brenda, hastiada de su vida en la mansión Hetton, que es el orgullo y la alegría de su marido, entabla relación con un solicitado joven londinense. Lo que empezó siendo una simple vía de escape, está a punto de derrumbar los pilares de su tradicional modo de vida. Adaptación de "A Handful of Dust", de Evelyn Waugh, un retrato de la alta sociedad inglesa del periodo de entreguerras que muestra el carácter artificioso y frío de unas relaciones sociales no exentas de cinismo y crueldad.

programme.title: Amor a Primera Visa
programme.desc: Rachel es una mujer moderna e inteligente cuya prioridad es su carrera diplomática en la Embajada Americana, lo que le obliga a estar viajando continuamente. Tras su fiesta de despedida en Ciudad de Mexico y a punto de trasladarse a Londres, despierta aun bajo los efectos del alcohol, en el apartamento de Alejandro , un apuesto mariachi y padre soltero.

programme.title: Love’s Melody
programme.desc: Arina es camarera en un restaurante, cría a su querido hijo Nikita y cuida de su madre enferma. Su marido la abandonó hace doce años, dejándola sola con el bebé. Por ello ya no tiene fe en los hombres. En lo profundo de su corazón, sin embargo, Arina todavía sueña con convertirse en cantante, pero hace tiempo abandonó sus ambiciones por el bien de su familia.

programme.title: Conversaciones con otras Mujeres
programme.desc: En una boda en un hotel de Nueva York, un hombre y una mujer de unos cuarenta años se conocen y entablan una ingeniosa conversación llena de dobles sentidos. Ella fuma continuamente y él bebe sin cesar, mientras ambos despliegan sus estrategias para acercarse. Ella, con su acento británico y su habilidad para mantener a los hombres a distancia, atrae su atención con sus ocurrencias. Él, por su parte, utiliza múltiples tácticas para asediarla, resultando finalmente irresistible.

programme.title: La Celda
programme.desc: Paco vive con su mujer Elena en una celda custodiada por dos inquietantes cuidadores, que pretenden conseguir una cesión de poderes para hacerse con el control de su bodega.

programme.title: El mal hijo
programme.desc: Varias chicas aparecen asesinadas a las afueras de la ciudad de Seattle. El principal sospechoso es un apuesto joven que parece poseer un imán para relacionarse con las mujeres. El problema llega cuando la policía y el FBI, no consiguen demostrar su culpabilidad. Todo apunta a que alguien está manipulando los archivos de las oficinas policiales.

programme.title: Desafío
programme.desc: Un grupo de amigas adolescentes decide poner en marcha el juego llamado "triple dog", el desafío, basado en unas reglas y pruebas constantes hacia los miembros del grupo. A medida que los desafíos se vuelven más extremos, las cosas se tuercen y lo que empieza siendo un juego divertido y desenfadado acabará por convertirse en una auténtica pesadilla.

programme.title: El jinete del amanecer
programme.desc: Una emocionante historia de venganza y pasión ambientada en el oeste americano. Cuando el padre del pistolero John Mason es asesinado por unos bandidos enmascarados, Mason sale en busca de venganza. Durante su búsqueda se enamora de Alice, involucrándose en un triángulo amoroso sombrío ya que Alice es la prometida de su mejor amigo.

programme.title: Presunto Secuestro
programme.desc: Inspirado en una historia real. Elle es secuestrada, maltratada, atormentada y luego liberada de repente a un costado del camino, sin explicación. Su novio Billy y su hermana Jen corren en su ayuda después de que es recuperada por la policía.

programme.title: Emergencias
programme.desc: Situaciones de emergencias al límite.

programme.title: Matar por popularidad
programme.desc: Cuando una misteriosa cuenta en las redes sociales comienza a publicar rumores sobre los escándalos de un instituto de un pequeño pueblo, una adolescente problemática y su mejor amiga se proponen desenmascarar al culpable, con consecuencias mortales.

programme.title: Traición conyugal
programme.desc: Tras descubrir que su marido no es el hombre que ella creyo conocer, Cathy Coulter es acusada de un asesinato que no cometio. Para salvar la vida de su hijo, y la suya propia, Cathy debe escapar de la justicia... y su unica salida es encontrar al verdadero asesino, antes que este los encuentre primero.

programme.title: El final del asesino de libros
programme.desc: Cuando Agatha Sayers, una autora superventas, contrata a una nueva asistente que se muda con ella, el peligro parece empezar a acecharla. La hija de Agatha es secuestrada y la persona responsable está copiando la trama del último libro de Agatha. Un libro que aún no se ha publicado. Agatha comienza a sospechar que su nueva asistente es mucho más peligrosa de lo que parece, y debe hacer todo lo posible para salvar a su hija antes de que su asistente escriba un final mortal.

programme.title: Los Hijos de Allen Funt
programme.desc: Entre las paredes de una habitación blanca, cinco personas viven confinadas. A diario, son obligadas a participar en una votación que permitirá al ganador lograr la recompensa prometida de salir al exterior. Uno de ellos tendrá la oportunidad de conseguirlo.

programme.title: Doble venganza

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.
